parsed.visual_overview: A live-action talk show setting where a female interviewer and a male learner sit at a table. The screen splits to show a CGI AI robot avatar interacting with the male presenter, correcting his English live. The ad ends with the male presenter delivering a direct call to action.

scenes.script_native:
Priya says: जिसको English नहीं आती, उसको native की तरह बोलने में कितना time लगता है?
Rahul says: सिर्फ 30 days.
Priya says: कैसे?
Rahul says: Supernova AI के साथ. देखो कैसे.
scenes.script_roman:
Priya says: Jisko English nahi aati, usko native ki tarah bolne mein kitna time lagta hai?
Rahul says: Sirf 30 days.
Priya says: Kaise?
Rahul says: Supernova AI ke saath. Dekho kaise.

scenes.script_native:
Miss Nova says: आपका नाम क्या है?
Rahul says: My name is Rahul.
Miss Nova says: आपकी age क्या है?
Rahul says: I have 39.
Miss Nova says: क्या आपका मतलब था, "I am 39"?
Rahul says: Oh yeah, right. I am 39.
Miss Nova says: Where are you from?
Rahul says: I am Delhi.
Miss Nova says: Nice try, पर आपको बोलना चाहिए, "I am from Delhi". और tension मत लीजिए, मैं सब कुछ Hindi में समझाती हूँ.
Rahul says: I'm sorry, मैं mistakes करता हूँ.
scenes.script_roman:
Miss Nova says: Aapka naam kya hai?
Rahul says: My name is Rahul.
Miss Nova says: Aapki age kya hai?
Rahul says: I have 39.
Miss Nova says: Kya aapka matlab tha, "I am 39"?
Rahul says: Oh yeah, right. I am 39.
Miss Nova says: Where are you from?
Rahul says: I am Delhi.
Miss Nova says: Nice try, par aapko bolna chahiye, "I am from Delhi". Aur tension mat lijiye, main sab kuch Hindi mein samjhati hoon.
Rahul says: I'm sorry, main mistakes karta hoon.

scenes.script_native: Miss Nova says: कोई बात नहीं! गलतियां करने से ही तो speaking practice होती है. मेरे साथ 1 crore से ज़्यादा लोग Supernova AI पर English बोलना सीख रहे हैं. आप बस रोज़ 10-15 minutes practice कीजिए.
scenes.script_roman: Miss Nova says: Koi baat nahi! Galtiyan karne se hi toh speaking practice hoti hai. Mere saath 1 crore se zyada log Supernova AI par English bolna seekh rahe hain. Aap bas roz 10-15 minutes practice kijiye.

scenes.script_native: Rahul says: मैं तो आज ही download कर रहा हूँ! तुम भी Supernova AI install करो और 30 days में अपनी English improve करो.
scenes.script_roman: Rahul says: Main toh aaj hi download kar raha hoon! Tum bhi Supernova AI install karo aur 30 days mein apni English improve karo.
